rules.statement: A tenant can set off overpaid rent against future rent payments within a three-year period preceding the claim, and this appropriation must be made in the most favorable way for the tenant.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore, if the overpayments of rent made by the defendant during the three years immediately preceding 1.3.'50 were appropriated by the landlord on the principles set out above, the defendant would not have been in arrear of rent at the time of the institution of the action."
